subject.title: Crestodian talk-to-agent command can miss the app handoff

question: Should the exact documented `talk to agent` selector be a deterministic host-navigation command through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102883, or remain model-owned until a broader Crestodian boundary review?
rationale: Current source deliberately makes usable-model Crestodian turns AI-owned, but the macOS onboarding contract needs a deterministic app handoff for the documented completion command and the linked PR bundles related restart/migration changes.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Accept deterministic exact host navigation and the bundled restart/profile fixes after maintainer review of the broader PR.

options.title: Narrow the handoff fix first
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that only makes exact `talk to agent` host-side while leaving restart and approval migration changes separate.

options.title: Keep model-owned navigation
options.body: Reject the deterministic handoff exception and accept that a model text-only reply can leave users in Crestodian.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Accept deterministic exact host navigation and the bundled restart/profile fixes after maintainer review of the broader PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to the issue, introduced the relevant Crestodian/macOS onboarding boundary, and authored the open candidate fix.
